paras: This MQB Cold Air Intake System for the 2.0T engine guarantees greater air induction volume, colder intake air temperature and smoother air flow for superior power gain.

Made with high grade full aluminum 3.5’inch diameter ensuring greater, smoother air flow with minimal restrictions and effective heat dispersion. LEYO R&D team also optioned for quality proven LEYO pod filter element for uncompromised filtration, performance and ease of maintenance
hl: Track and dyno proven for greater horsepower gain.
ft: Cold Air Intake System V2 1.8/20T MQB - Audi A3 S3 8V / TT 8S & Volkswagen Golf MK7/7.5 MK8 GTI
